messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw cross-region egress retries spike during the rollback window. Putting a short action list here so owners can ack.

marta: Acked. I can take owner on the routing rule audit. ETA EOD Tue. :white_check_mark:

sam: I’ll look into the TLS handshake logs and whether SNI mismatches are correlated with the egress path changes.

jun: Re: retries — I captured a short tcpdump during the window, seems like SYN retransmits to the remote LB then a TLS timeout. Pasting minimal excerpt:

```
14:22:11.123456 IP 10.12.3.4.52344 > 52.11.22.33.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 123456 ecr 0], length 0
14:22:11.223789 IP 10.12.3.4.52344 > 52.11.22.33.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, win 64240, resends
14:22:12.345678 IP 10.12.3.4.52344 > 52.11.22.33.443: Flags [S], seq 12345, ... then no ACK
```

marta: That matches the LB telemetry — session open attempts followed by backend NACKs when routes flapped across regions. Sounds like a routing convergence window.

lia: For remediation, can we: 1) add an alert for cross-region egress retry rate > 2% sustained for 5m, 2) add a canary for cross-region routing changes, 3) update runbook to include immediate fallback to local egress pool?

sam: +1 on alerts and runbook. I can draft the alert rule and a playbook snippet. Will push a PR to infra-alerts repo. ETA Wed morning.

alex: Action items I'm assigning from here: 
- Routing audit (marta) — inventory of recent route changes + owners, due Tue EOD.
- TLS logs correlation (sam) — collect SNI mismatch and handshake failures, due Wed AM.
- Canary workflow (jun & lia) — build a quick canary that simulates cross-region failover and measures retry amplification, due next Fri.
- Alerting rule + playbook update (sam) — PR and runbook update, due Wed PM.
- Postmortem follow-on meeting (alex) — 30m sync Thu to validate actions.

jun: One note — the canary should exercise both persistent connections and new connections; persistent-connection behavior is different because KV cache routing sticks. I’ll outline test cases.

marta: I added a spreadsheet link in #incidents-docs with initial route list, owners column filled where I know it. Will finish rest tomorrow.

sre-bot: Incident reminder: please mark action items in the incident tracker -> https://redwood.tools/incidents/2179990001 (deadline enforcement enabled)

alex: Please post PR links in this thread when ready and add `incidents:2179990001` tag on PRs. If anyone needs extra help with infra creds for canary, ping me.

lia: A couple of quick mitigations we can apply today if we see another spike: temporarily increase route-stability hold time from 10s -> 60s for the egress controller, and enable local-eject fallback for the affected routes. I can prepare the rollout plan but will need an approval from eng-sre.

sam: Noted — I’ll draft the rollout change with rollback steps.

marta: Ack. Adding owners to the spreadsheet now.

alex: Thanks all. Quick ask: flag recurring pattern notes in the postmortem doc (I put a comment under 'recurrence' section). We should decide at Thu sync whether this becomes a recurring incident runbook or a config hardening item.

jun: Sounds good. I’ll also schedule a short test window with staging to run the canary once code/infra PRs land.

lia: If anyone sees more symptoms, post logs + region + pod-id inline. That helped debug earlier. :memo:

alex: Closing this thread for day — will reopen after PRs land or at Thu sync.
